facts.activity_file: setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices

control_failures.control_label: controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.title: preventive action - alarm philosophy conformance on PSV-8210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on PSV-8210 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on PSV-8210 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. PSV-8210 (steam relief devices) is in service for boiler and deaerator overpressure protection. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 18 March 2022 a corrective action on PSV-8210 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
